definitions.gloss: lending rate; interest rate on loans
definitions.explanation: The rate of interest a bank charges when it lends money. Contrasted with the deposit rate a bank pays to savers; the gap between them is the bank's margin.

examples.japanese: {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}が{上|あ}がった。
{銀行|ぎんこう}によって{貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}が{違|ちが}うので、{比|くら}べたほうがいい。
examples.english: Lending rates differ by bank, so it's better to compare.

examples.japanese: {日銀|にちぎん}が{政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げれば、{各行|かくこう}の{貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}にも{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: If the Bank of Japan raises its policy rate, bank lending rates will be affected too.

notes:
A standard term in banking and financial news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}が{上|あ}がる／{下|さ}がる: lending rates rise / fall
- {貸出|かしだし}{金利|きんり}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise the lending rate
- {低|てい}{金利|きんり}: low interest rates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {預金|よきん}{金利|きんり}: deposit rate — what the bank pays you, the mirror image of this term
- {政策|せいさく}{金利|きんり}: policy rate — the central bank's benchmark, which drives lending rates
- {利息|りそく}: interest — the money itself, not the rate
